name: Qi Refinement Sword
desc: An iron sword forged by a local blacksmith, barely usable.

name: Qi Refinement Saber
desc: A thick-backed chopper, a favorite of ordinary martial artists.

name: Qi Refinement Spear
desc: Made of white wax wood, with a red tassel on the spearhead.

name: Qi Refinement Staff
desc: A common hardwood staff, as long as the eyebrows.

name: Qi Refinement Fan
desc: A folding fan commonly used by scholars and literati for elegance.

name: Qi Refinement Whip
desc: A common leather whip, mostly used for driving carts or punishment.

name: Qi Refinement Zither
desc: An ancient zither made of paulownia wood, with fair sound quality.

name: Qi Refinement Flute
desc: Carved from purple bamboo, with a crisp sound.

name: Qi Refinement Hidden Weapon
desc: Commonly seen iron hidden weapons.

name: Azure Frost Sword
desc: The sword qi is bone-chillingly cold.

name: Water Moon Saber
desc: The blade is like water, reflecting the moon without a trace. It is hard to distinguish between reality and illusion, making it unpredictable for opponents.

name: Fire Tipped Spear
desc: Faint fire light on the spearhead, able to trigger common fire.

name: Dragon Capturing Rod
desc: Forged from refined iron, weighing a thousand jin, usable by those with great strength.

name: Crimson Flower Fan
desc: The fan is painted with crimson petals. The flower shadows are blurred, hiding murderous intent, making it impossible to guard against.

name: God Striking Whip
desc: An imitation; although lacking the power to strike gods, it can wound the soul.

name: Heavenly Demonic Zither
desc: The zither sound is demonic, disturbing the mind.

name: Spirit Controlling Flute
desc: The sound of the flute is shrill and can control corpses, making people turn pale at the sound.

name: Shadowless Needle
desc: Fine as a cow's hair, coming and going without a trace, impossible to guard against.

name: Ten Thousand Beasts Flute
desc: Specially made by the Baishou Sect; the flute sound can soothe or provoke beasts.

name: Bloodthirsty Saber
desc: The blade is crimson, seemingly thirsting for blood. It has a heavy killing intent and cannot be used by those with weak will.

name: Meteor Heavy Sword
desc: Cast from extraterrestrial meteoric iron. The heavy sword has no sharp edge, but great skill requires no workmanship. It can break all techniques with force.

name: Spirit Snake Soft Sword
desc: The sword is as soft as silk, but when infused with spiritual energy, it moves like a spirit snake, strange and unpredictable.

name: Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff
desc: A standard weapon of the Zhenhun Sect, combining water and fire to trap enemies and lock souls.

name: Heavenly Thunder Bamboo Sword
desc: A set of flying swords refined from Heavenly Thunder Bamboo, containing the Evil-Warding Divine Thunder to suppress all evil in the world.

name: As-You-Will Iron Rod
desc: The weapon of the Six-Eared Macaque, changing as desired, as large or small as one wishes.

name: Five Fires Seven Poultry Fan
desc: The fan surface features five fires including air fire, stone fire, and wood fire, turning things to ashes in one wave.

name: God Killer Spear
desc: Surging killing intent, once stained with the blood of demon gods; the spear never returns once thrown.

name: Crimson Blood War Spear
desc: Crimson throughout, with overwhelming fighting spirit. It has been stained with the blood of countless strong men, and the spear strikes without regret.

name: Immortal Slaying Flying Dagger
desc: A trace of light hidden in a red gourd, with eyebrows and eyes. Please turn around, treasure, for gods and ghosts cannot escape.

name: Immortal Slaying Sword
desc: Neither copper, iron, nor steel, once hidden under Mount Sumeru. Sharp qi pierces directly into the nine heavens.

name: Gan Jiang and Mo Ye
desc: Swords of true love, one female and one male, killing when separated, amorous when together.

name: Plantain Fan
desc: Essence leaf of Taiyin; one wave stops fire, two waves create wind, three waves bring rain.

name: Purple Gold Demon Subduing Pestle
desc: Wei Hu's weapon; although light and agile, it hits with the weight of Mount Tai.

name: Nine-Ring Golden Saber
desc: The back of the saber is embedded with nine golden rings. When waved, the rings collide with a thunderous sound that strikes fear into the heart.

name: Cold Iron Silver Spear
desc: Made entirely of ten-thousand-year-old cold iron, the spear body is silvery white and bone-chilling to the touch.

name: Seven-Section Purple Bamboo Whip
desc: Harvested from the Purple Bamboo Forest in the South Sea, it has seven sections and is exceptionally tough. It can wound enemies and bind demons.

name: Jade Pipa
desc: Carved from white jade, it produces the sound of metal and stone when played, cleansing inner demons.

name: Ocean Dragon Flute
desc: Made of deep-sea cold jade. When played, it sounds like a dragon chanting in the ocean, shaking the surroundings.

name: Fierce Tiger Evil Blade
desc: An ancient ominous weapon sealing the fierce soul of a White Tiger. It must drink blood when unsheathed and may backlash against its master.

name: Sky Optimus Pillar
desc: Refined from fragments of pillars suspected to be from the Ancient Heavenly Court. It is as heavy as a mountain and cannot be wielded by those without great power.

name: Yin Yang Fan
desc: One side is pure white for life, the other pitch black for death. Waving it reverses Yin and Yang, shrinking the earth to inches.

name: Dragon Spine Whip
desc: Refined from the spine of an ancient true dragon. When waved, there is a faint dragon roar, naturally suppressing lower-level beings.

name: Fuxi Zither
desc: An imitation of one of the Ten Great Ancient Artifacts, possessing the mysterious power to dominate the minds of all things.

name: Demon Calling Flute
desc: A supreme treasure of the Demon Realm. The flute sound is treacherous and can drive monsters and fierce beasts for one's own use.

name: Seven-Color Sparrow Feather
desc: Beautiful beyond words, but hidden under the brilliant light is a fatal murderous intent.
